---
title: "3. Build Zarr Cubes"
---

The code to build the cubes is in `code/build_cubes.py`. The code is pulled in directly from that file, so the website never gets out of sync with the code.



```{.python filename="code/build_cubes.py"}
{{< include ../code/build_cubes.py >}}
```

Run it:

```bash
python code/build_cubes.py --output-dir data/cubes
```

## Exercises

1. Build a cube with different variables and/or dimensions. You can use the `--variables` and `--dimensions` flags to specify which variables and dimensions to include in the cube.
